software.name: pv-dimensionality-reduction
software.title: Filter and wrapper diagnostics of dimensionality reduction for endogenous PV power forecasting (MATLAB)

article.citation: H. Bouzgou, G. Chesnoiu, C. F. Nicolosi, A. Chatel, G. Notton, L. Menard, C. Voyant. Dimensionality reduction with redundancy awareness for parsimonious PV power time series forecasting
article.status: manuscript in preparation; no result of it is reported here

supported: test whether compressing the lagged input helps a PV forecast
out_of_scope: results of the manuscript in preparation

inputs.definition: PV power series of the study (data/ folder)

outputs.definition: errors by method and dimension, parameter reduction against the full-input ELM, baselines

rules: Never invent a value. Each input is given by the user, an exact unit conversion of a given value, or a documented default that the user explicitly accepts.
Use the canonical unit of each field; convert exactly and say so (for example 2 km -> 2000 m). Never mix a percentage and a fraction.
Ask when a request is ambiguous or a required input is missing; do not infer a number from a place name or a qualitative word.
Run the code unmodified. Report only what was actually computed, with quantity, unit and the input values used; never present a planned or unavailable run as a result.
State the scope and the limits below when you report a result.
Results belong to a manuscript in preparation.
limits: Parallel Computing Toolbox recommended (parfor); bundled drtoolbox third-party code, see THIRD_PARTY.md.
